added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arms: baseline_suite failure_ids has one id (test_export_determinism.py::TestManifestDeterminism::test_no_commit_uses_stable_unversioned_timestamp) and after_suite carries the same single id, so the change adds none. findings.text: non-blocking: _move_sources_to_name runs the move and supersession through services.GraphClient().query and then records the receipts in a second autocommit query, so the docstring at graph_source_bindings.py:1632 and the evidence fragment's claim that the compose and attach writers run the move and its receipts in one transaction are false; a failure between the two leaves a superseded name with no StandardNameChange, which the inline CREATE it replaced did not allow.

non-blocking: the guard suppresses the last_source_supersede receipt on every record_change=False retarget (edit.py:1944, graph_refinement.py:1329, graph_supersession.py:4139, provenance_lifecycle.py:2231), where the base wrote it inline; the drained pair is always (old_name, new_name), so the second condition is unreachable and the guard means drained_old and record_change while reading as though it excepted a different pair.

non-blocking: assert winners == ["dd:test/last_source/one"] compares the return against the same sns_id the test passed in, so it holds whatever the writer does with the binding; the real guard for this case is the graph read at tests/standard_names/test_last_source_supersede.py:318.

non-blocking: the compose, attach and staged cases assert the lifecycle and the producer but never read the receipt, so the receipt half of the one-receipt change is unguarded on the three writers it rewrote and a dropped record_supersede_receipts call there would redden nothing.

non-blocking: the gate table credits the graph arm to a head that is not the delivered head - graph-head.log's own header reads revision head-graph-96ef090ed - so the recorded gate does not cover 0b1962a89's rewrite of _MOVE_SOURCE_BINDING_CYPHER and the attach/compose writers; re-run at ac6dc98bd it passes 8/8.
